newsitem.title: USA: Polygram Holding names financial chief.
newsitem.headline: Polygram Holding names financial chief.

text.p: Polygram Holding Inc on Tuesday said Helen Murphy was promoted to chief financial officer, overseeing the financial and administrative areas of the Polygram Music Group in the United States.

Previously, Murphy served as worldwide senior vice president for investor relations at Polygram International Ltd, and in the United States as senior vice president for mergers and acquisitions at PolyGram Holding Inc since December 1995.
Polgyram Holding Inc, a unit of Dutch music and entertainment company PolyGram NV, is the U.S. holding company for all of Polygram's U.S. music interests.
Murphy will replace William Feeny, who is assuming a soon-to-be announced position in London.
